explanation: OEIS A024356 (determinant of the n×n Hankel matrix with entries prime(i+j−1)): 'I conjecture that a(4) is the only zero.' The formal a uses Nat.nth Nat.Prime (i + j) with 0-based i, j (prime(1) = 2 in the corner), so a(0) = 1 (empty determinant), matching the OEIS convention. Stating the biconditional (a(n) = 0 iff n = 4) correctly captures 'the only zero'. Faithful.
